scope.name: AdvanceMap 1.92 legacy import

focal_files.whole_file_scope: Three parser entry points: legacy binary .map dimensions, border and metatile decoding; .bvd RSE/FRLG identification, length/count checks, tile words, versioned attributes and optional triple-layer padding; four-byte-stride palette decoding; errors and allocated result ownership.
All three declarations, parameter and pointer contracts, and result ownership expectations.

dependency_context_only.edge: MainWindow invokes parseLayout and decides how an imported Layout is retained or deleted.
Tileset editor consumes returned Metatile pointers and chooses primary or secondary limits.
Palette loader delegates non-JASC palettes to parsePalette; PaletteUtil's wider behavior is not reviewed here.
Ordered tileset labels, allowed primary/secondary label sets, defaults and metatile count limits.
Configured/fallback tileset label definitions; earlier Project writer/save coverage is context, not repeated.
Configuration selects version-dependent attribute size and triples-layer behavior.
Metatile tile and attribute destination API.
RSE/FRLG attribute widths and bit-field conversion. This implementation is stubbed, not executed, in the native parser harness.
Imported dimensions, labels, Blockdata and downstream layout save/model API.
Builds original parser into the Qt Core/GUI application.
Pinned root notice context; no legal or redistribution-compliance conclusion.

unresolved: No original independent semantic dossier or attributable review receipt is present for either focal file.
The native harness substitutes Project/Layout/Tile/Metatile/logging types; real object ownership, Metatile attribute packing, and GUI caller decisions remain untested.
The parseLayout dimension product has signed-overflow undefined behavior for a crafted 65536-by-65536 header; the bounded UBSan witness records this, but no upstream source is changed.
Zero dimensions, non-null error-pointer preconditions, giant dimensions, and all malformed file forms require independent semantic review.
No actual AdvanceMap-produced corpus, complete GUI import, downstream ROM build, gameplay, or hardware behavior is exercised.
Pinned licensing text and notice identity do not establish distribution compliance.

native_witness.source: unchanged pinned src/core/advancemapparser.cpp compiled with Qt6Core and Qt6Gui and test-only model/logging stubs
positive_and_negative_controls: layout field decode, little-endian metatile values, valid tileset indices, and cross-kind fallback
RSE and FRLG .bvd version decoding, tile order, attribute widths, and triple-layer padding
palette RGB channels, four-byte stride, and malformed length rejection
UBSan reports signed overflow for a 65536x65536 .map dimension product
not_tested: MainWindow/TilesetEditor GUI execution and pointer ownership transitions
real AdvanceMap exports or FireRed ROM compatibility
